meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create, refine, and benchmark agent skills. Use when building a new skill, updating an existing one, running evals, checking trigger quality, or improving a skill description.

copy.tagline: 创建、优化和评测 agent 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建或改进 agent 技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, refine, and benchmark agent skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build or improve agent skills

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你创建、改进和测试技能。它会引导你完成需求分析、编写技能文件、生成测试用例、运行对比评估，并根据结果迭代优化。
howto.when: 当你提出要创建新技能、改进现有技能、运行评估或优化技能触发条件时，Claude 会主动进入这个流程。

say.text: 帮我创建一个整理下载文件夹的技能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义技能行为、触发词和输出格式。

say.text: 改进我已有的技能，让它更准确。
say.note: Claude 会运行评估并基于结果提出修改建议。

say.text: 给这个技能写几个测试用例。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试提示并保存到 evals.json。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create, refine, and test agent skills. It guides you through requirement analysis, writing skill files, generating test cases, running comparative evaluations, and iterating based on results.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create a new skill, improve an existing one, run evaluations, or optimize skill triggers, Claude will proactively enter this workflow.

say_en.text: Create a skill to organize my Downloads folder.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining behavior, triggers, and output format.

say_en.text: Improve my existing skill to make it more accurate.
say_en.note: Claude will run evaluations and suggest modifications based on results.

say_en.text: Write a few test cases for this skill.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test prompts and save them to evals.json.
